assumptions: wall friction mu = 0.3 (assumed; no source in the repository, 確かめていない)
a beam element breaks (is removed) when the plastic hinge rotation at one of its ends passes 60 deg (assumed; no source in the repository, 確かめていない)
smaller pieces broken off the seats' side, touching the rest by the element contact: at 13.3 ms, 5 nodes (1.5 % of the mass: cross_F)

unsupported_load: the parts with mass put on no mesh node (each part's mass goes on its carried_by nodes, or the nearest support's node; whether a part's shape touches the frame is the hand calculation's path check, load_path.free_parts): none

frame_split_fraction: the largest share of the whole mass in a piece broken off the seats' side with a node in an occupant part box's y-z extent, ahead of its rear face, at the start (a piece that can come into their space); 1 other piece(s) cannot and are not counted
crush_margin: crumple_length (the front-most node to the front face of the front-most occupant part box, along x, at the start) less max_crush
occupant_space_margin: the least room over the run from the structure ahead of an occupant part box to the box's front face (occupant_space_left; negative: the structure is inside the box)
hot_spots: each frame member's least room (over the run) to an occupant part box, read as occupant_space_left (the place's occupant_space_margin)

part boxes past the wall face, taken as crushed against it (the boxes have no contact; they move with their carried_by nodes): wheel_FR 98.0 mm, wheel_FL 96.5 mm, front_body 57.5 mm, fit_front_body_tower_post_RA1 46.6 mm, fit_front_body_tower_post_LA1 46.6 mm, fit_front_body_cross_F 15.0 mm

member_axial_force.<member> (N, + tension): of the member's elements not broken then, the axial force E A / L0 (length - L0 - plastic elongation) of the largest size, 0 when all are broken; member_hinge.<member>.<end node> (deg): the plastic hinge rotation sqrt(theta_y^2 + theta_z^2) at that end of the member; both at the node_motion field's frames

the frame as 166 co-rotational 3-D beam elements on 156 nodes (each member in up to 4 elements, none shorter than 3.5 radii of gyration of its section), explicit central differences, time step 6.19 us = 0.8 (Courant factor) x the elements' stable step 2 / omega_max; the rotational inertia of the nodes scaled up to at least (element mass / 2) x length^2 / 12 per element end (rotational mass scaling: no translational mass is added)

elastic-perfectly plastic: axial yield at A f_y, plastic hinges at the element ends at M_p = Z_p f_y about each local axis on its own, reduced by the axial force as M_p (1 - (N / N_p)^2), torsion capped at the plastic torque; the plastic deformation stays (no spring back); no strain hardening, no strain-rate effect, no local buckling of the tube walls (a tube squashes at A f_y instead of folding progressively)

mass 646.2 kg: frame 58.8 kg on its element nodes, parts 587.4 kg; the other parts without carried_by (suspension) as point masses at their nearest support's frame node: RL 6.7 kg at LB, RR 6.7 kg at RB, FL 4.9 kg at LA, FR 4.9 kg at RA; each part's mass in equal shares on its carried_by nodes, as point masses (the part's own rotational inertia and its stiffness are not in the model; it moves with those nodes); the wheels as nodes at their centres touching the wall at their radius (x + r > wall) through the tyre (the wall note says how), joined to the frame by pin-ended links standing in for the suspension arms (axial springs only, no bending, no yield, never broken; stiffness set from the time step: each link's frequency 0.2 x the frame elements' highest, far stiffer than the arms): wheel_FL (wheel_FL + knuckle_FL + caliper_FL, 18.0 kg, radius 300 mm) to LAl1, LAl2, LAu1, LAu2 (the arms' brackets (found through connects_to)); wheel_FR (wheel_FR + knuckle_FR + caliper_FR, 18.0 kg, radius 300 mm) to RAl1, RAl2, RAu1, RAu2 (the arms' brackets (found through connects_to)); wheel_RL (wheel_RL + knuckle_RL + caliper_RL, 18.0 kg, radius 300 mm) to LB, LBd, LBm, LE (the arms' brackets (found through connects_to), with the support's frame node and the design nodes nearest the wheel); wheel_RR (wheel_RR + knuckle_RR + caliper_RR, 18.0 kg, radius 300 mm) to RB, RBd, RBm, RE (the arms' brackets (found through connects_to), with the support's frame node and the design nodes nearest the wheel); section capacities: plastic moduli (K0 frame_inputs.plastic_modulus), plastic torque 2 A_m t fy / sqrt 3

the wall: a rigid plane x = 415 mm, at the front-most of the frame's nodes (LF, RF, cross_F~1, cross_F~2, cross_F~3, x = 400 mm) and the part boxes they carry; it touches the frame's nodes by a penalty spring 1 x the node's mass / dt^2, and the wheel nodes through the tyre: when a wheel centre's x + its radius passes the wall, a spring of the tyre's radial stiffness on the deflection (compressive only, no damping: the tyre gives back what it holds); when the deflection reaches the tyre's section height the rim is at the wall and stops there, perfectly plastic (no spring-back from the rim; HIRAKU's choice, the rim's own crushing is not modelled). wheel_FL: 150 N/mm, section height 120 mm, rim radius 180 mm; wheel_FR: 150 N/mm, section height 120 mm, rim radius 180 mm; wheel_RL: 150 N/mm, section height 120 mm, rim radius 180 mm; wheel_RR: 150 N/mm, section height 120 mm, rim radius 180 mm; the tyre spring on the wheel node's mass (omega dt)^2 = k_t dt^2 / m = 3.2e-07 at most (the kernel allows 1); the part boxes and the bumper do not touch the wall
tyre radial stiffness for the wall contact: the vertical stiffness tyre_stiffness, taken as the same in the radial direction (not checked): 150 N/mm, the design's tyre_stiffness
the tyre's section height (the deflection at which the rim reaches the wall): 40 % of the wheel radius (HIRAKU's assumption; the design gives no rim)

contact between the frame's elements that share no node (pieces broken apart, a member folding onto another), frictionless: each element a capsule of radius half its section's larger outer dimension (pairs closer than that at the start, near the joints: from their starting distance); a penalty spring 0.05 x the contact point's mass / dt^2 between the closest points of the two axes, the force shared to the four nodes (momentum kept); the pairs looked at are listed again whenever a node has moved 5 mm relative to the rest (the list keeps the pairs within 10 mm of touching). In this run: 13489 pairs can touch, the list made 88 times, at most 24 pairs on it, 37124 pair-steps in contact. The wheels and the part boxes do not touch the elements
no gravity and no ground (the crash forces are many times the weight over the run)

peak_decel and the deceleration series: the whole mass's deceleration, the wall's impulse over each 1 ms / (the total mass x 1 ms), recorded every 0.1 ms; peak_decel is the input to the occupants (the deceleration of the whole vehicle they ride in, not of the seat mounts on their own); mean_decel: the speed lost / the time to the stop

max_crush and the crush series: how far the occupants' seat mount nodes (LS1, LS2, RS1, RS2) moved toward the wall after the frame's front-most node reached it (the shortening of the structure ahead of them while the front is held at the wall; a broken-off front piece moving back from the wall is not counted)

occupant_space_left: the occupant part boxes move with their carried_by nodes; the least x distance over the run from the structure ahead of a box (mesh nodes and element middles inside the box's y-z extent, ahead of its rear face) back to the box's front face; negative: the structure is inside the box
run: the vehicle stopped (its speed toward the wall, its momentum / its mass, fell to 5 % of the start) at 67.3 ms (10880 steps); speed at the end 0.55 m/s
occupant_space_left at the start: 45 mm (the least over the run at 67.3 ms)
battery_mount_force: the battery's mass share on each of its carried_by nodes x the node's acceleration averaged over 1 ms (largest at 44.2 ms)
first yield at 1.39 ms
first break at 12.77 ms (rail_R_FA)
the largest crush at 67.3 ms
